overview: You left Saturday's sheet at home because you play this afternoon. The glass in its cloth is for the Jackdaw. Mistress Ansell's copper is on, and you do not buy the ink.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Left the sheet, and did not buy the ink.

parties.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
parties.context: Had the copper on. She did not come up.
